QUOTE: `LlamaCppBackend::tokenize` (`llama_cpp_backend.cpp:788-800`) returns `{}` when no tokenizer is wired, and otherwise passes the result through unchanged.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the backend wrapper returns `{}` when no tokenizer is wired and passes the tokenizer's `{}` failure result through unchanged. It also says a real failure and empty input look the same to the caller. That makes failure and no-tokenizer the same empty value.
